item.title: Energy Department Announces Virginia and West Virginia Transmission Project to Receive Defense Production Act Funding, Strengthening National Security and Grid Reliability
item.description: The U.S. Department of Energy today announced its intent to deploy Defense Production Act (DPA) funding to accelerate the expansion of transmission capacity in Virginia and West Virginia, strengthening grid reliability and infrastructure essential to national defense.

item.title: Energy Department Announces 2026 Ernest Orlando Lawrence Award Winners
item.description: The Secretary of Energy today announced nine recipients of the prestigious Ernest Orlando Lawrence Award for their exceptional contributions to research and development supporting the U.S. Department of Energy’s missions in science, energy, and national security.

item.title: Energy Secretary Secures Mid-Atlantic Grid Ahead of Anticipated Stressed System Conditions
item.description: The Secretary issues an emergency order to stabilize the mid-Atlantic grid and mitigate the risk of blackouts

item.title: Energy Department Authorizes Strategic Petroleum Reserve Exchange to Address Supply Disruptions Due to Hurricane
item.description: The U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) authorized the emergency exchange to alleviate supply disruption due to inclement weather in the Gulf of America

item.title: Energy Department Supports FERC’s Call for PJM to Protect Ratepayers and Build More Reliable Power
item.description: DOE urges PJM to require large new electricity users to pay for the generation and infrastructure needed to serve them.

item.title: Energy Department Launches Genesis Mission Graduate Fellowship to Advance American Scientific Leadership
item.description: Inaugural fellowship program aims to build a robust domestic, Super Intelligence (SI)-ready scientific workforce through dual-competency training and research experiences at DOE National Labs and with industry partners.
